mintAuthority.summary: Finalized Solana state at slot 452212543 keeps the MOVEUSD SPL mint and freeze authorities at the mint address, an off-curve program-derived address. Finalized transaction 4G6Asw...PE4wH3 at slot 432775304 proves that executable program EmiytJ3zWX9koH3emPsWDEs9RqNm6NNFp4CkMLoiA1KC can sign for that PDA and invoke MintToChecked. The program remains upgradeable; its current ProgramData names AiWGaHWRrSAizfXRPGypvxGoMgH714yr6cpRZgdKq2tr as upgrade authority, replacing the previously recorded 6fTsNdopg4K5nFBFoBhfiU7GnaEkVa3cvxHoVc1Q9Rw1. MOVEUSD retains a concentrated program-controlled mint route.

controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 452212543, upgradeable-loader ProgramData DybKXmycEuZDF4u8EVxr21Ljza9dEHKF6CKJ9G91zMMY for program EmiytJ3zWX9koH3emPsWDEs9RqNm6NNFp4CkMLoiA1KC names AiWGaHWRrSAizfXRPGypvxGoMgH714yr6cpRZgdKq2tr as upgrade authority and records deployment slot 449520764. The authority account is owned by the System Program, is non-executable, and has zero data. This replaces the authority recorded at finalized slot 439729740, 6fTsNdopg4K5nFBFoBhfiU7GnaEkVa3cvxHoVc1Q9Rw1; no multisig, timelock, or key-custody protection is established by the current account read.

review.evidence: Historical 2026-08-16 review: finalized chain state kept the SPL mint and freeze authorities self-referential, but the address was an off-curve PDA and finalized 2026-07-14 transactions proved program EmiytJ3z...oiA1KC actively signed for it to mint and burn MOVEUSD. ProgramData at slot 439729740 named 6fTsNdop...Q9Rw1 as upgrade authority. The prior fixed-supply conclusion was contradicted by on-chain execution. Economic-posture reviews on 2026-08-15 found no independent issuance bound, recurring reserve-to-supply reconciliation, or named prudential supervisor. Current 2026-10-01 review: an atomic finalized account read at slot 452212543 confirms unchanged mint/freeze authorities and the same executable mint program and ProgramData, but names AiWGaHWRrSAizfXRPGypvxGoMgH714yr6cpRZgdKq2tr as the current upgrade authority, with deployment slot 449520764. The new authority is a non-executable, zero-data System Program account; no multisig, timelock, or key-custody protection is established. The historical mint transaction was re-fetched and its correct slot is 432775304. CFX's current homepage, Trust Center, docs index, and product documentation continue to provide standing bank-deposit claims without a dated whole-supply reserve-to-liability report.
